rules: default build MRIS_FIX_TOPOLOGY_ERROR_MODE=1: defect+chull; alternate compile uses border
negative mappings and previously ripped records skip restore
save/restore orig/normal, nsizeCur/Max/vtotal/vnum/v2num/v3num and incident num/f/n
nfaces truncated only; face contents and non-DVS fields never backed up
source malloc(vtotal) then memcpy(vsize) is unsafe if vsize>vtotal; FNIT explicitly stores vsize
restoration requires saved vtotal match restored nsizeCur count
MRIStruncateNFaces changes logical nfaces and topology revision, no face payload restoration
MRISsetOriginalXYZ sets orig floats and signals active RealmTrees; caller of own DVS must invalidate spatial caches for report original_coordinate_restored_vertices
